answer: An AI agent economy can blunt Sybil attacks with a stake-and-attest web: an agent locks a bond before it may vouch for peers, so reputation has a price. A cloner gets no hollow shortcut; every fake node must post its own onyx stake, and caught collusion slashes the entire ledge of collateral at once. Cost to the attacker rises per forged identity while honest verification stays flat, so mass impersonation never pays.
